name: @weavetab/mcp
description: The open automation engine for AI agents. Control live browsers and desktop apps locally with instant execution.
author: weavetab

browser_map.description: Snapshot interactive DOM with stable ref IDs (w:NN). Serves cached maps when the DOM has not mutated and runs a bounded load-stability wait only on cold walks. Supports delta temporal diffing, semantic pruning, Set-of-Marks visual grounding (visual: true / "auto"), AX tree fallback (Shadow DOM traversal), scope/query filtering, and forced rebuilds with loop strike reset (force: true).
features: Cached map reuse with bounded cold-walk stability wait and depth: 0 DOM init
Semantic DOM pruning and per-tab delta diffing
Set-of-Marks visual grounding (visual: true / "auto")
Per-tab snapshot temporal diffing (delta mode)
O(N) backendNodeId ref resolution and Shadow DOM / AX tree fallback
Scope and query filtering for complex SPAs
Loop strike counter reset on forced re-mapping (force: true)

browser_navigate.description: Navigate to a URL. Enforces domain security policies and rate limits prior to navigation, skips web cookie-banner auto-clicks in Electron/non-HTTP contexts, and guarantees a non-empty title fallback. Supports internal protocol schemes (e.g. weavetab://).
features: Domain policy engine and blocklist enforcement
Deterministic DOM stability and network idle waiting
Electron/non-HTTP safe navigation with non-empty title fallback
weavetab:// internal protocol support
Targeted tab navigation via tab_id

browser_click.description: Click a DOM element. Physical click engine incorporating Bézier curve trajectory kinematics (Ghost Cursor). Multi-stage targeting fallback: mark number (SoM visual grounding) -> ref ID -> selector -> label -> intent -> coordinates -> backendNodeId. Supports force: true to bypass pointer-event occlusion checks; post-click map rebuild is opt-in via include_map.
features: Direct mark number targeting (mark: N) from visual mode
Bézier curve trajectory kinematics with humanized acceleration
Multi-stage fallback targeting resolution and Shadow DOM targeting
Intent-based historical strategy resolution
Optional occlusion bypass (force: true) and actionable occlusion hints
Opt-in post-click page map retrieval (include_map)

browser_type.description: Type text into a single input field or the active focused element. Keystroke dispatch engine with per-character temporal jitter, burst profiling, and stuck-input detection. Skips fuzzy ambiguity checks when an explicit ref ID or CSS selector is given. Supports atomic clear/clearFirst and clipboard paste modes.
features: Per-character temporal jitter and burst keystroke profiling
Zero-target activeElement typing and anti-unfocus click avoidance
Exact ref/selector targeting without fuzzy false-positive ambiguity errors
Stuck-typing loop detection via DOM diffing
Atomic input clearing (clear / clearFirst) across both keystroke and paste modes

browser_type_secret.description: Inject a secret from secrets.json without exposing values to the LLM context. Enforces strict domain scoping (blocks empty-hostname URLs like file:// and about:blank), supports exact ref IDs, CSS selectors, or target: 'focused', and masks values as [REDACTED] across all reads and logs.
features: Zero LLM context exposure for credentials
Domain-scoped authorization blocking empty-hostname URLs (file://, about:blank)
Exact ref ID, CSS selector, or focused activeElement targeting
DOM property hardening and permanent [REDACTED] masking across logs and reads

browser_key.description: Press a keyboard key or modifier combo (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta). Dispatches parsed native CDP key events with printable character text payloads and skips web form-submit fallbacks in Electron apps.
features: Native key code, key identifier, and printable text dispatch
Modifier key combination handling (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta)
Electron-safe Enter handling without blind ancestor clicks
Per-tab keyboard focus targeting

browser_scroll.description: Scroll the page or a targeted element via CDP wheel events. Automatically scrolls off-screen target containers into view before wheel dispatch and keeps extension HUD telemetry non-fatal.
features: Directional scrolling (up, down, left, right) with configurable distance
Auto-scrolls off-screen target containers into view before wheel events
Element-relative scroll targeting via ref ID or selector

browser_dialog.description: Accept or dismiss JS dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt) via CDP Page.handleJavaScriptDialog with safe toast escaping and deduplicated session listeners.
features: Handling of alert, confirm, and prompt modal types
Accept and dismiss actions with prompt text payload submission
Deduplicated dialog listener tracking and race-free state cleanup

browser_burst.description: HIGH-SPEED MULTI-ACTION PIPELINE: Executes 2 or more sequential browser actions in a single round-trip without waiting for LLM turns between steps. PREFER THIS over individual single-action calls to slash latency and token burn. Supports native primitives (browser_click, browser_fill, browser_type, browser_type_secret, browser_navigate, browser_key, browser_scroll, browser_wait, browser_map) plus compound macros (type_and_send, click_and_wait, navigate_and_read, scroll_and_read, fill_form). If compile_from_history: true is passed, automatically compiles and executes recent successful session trail actions into a burst macro.
features: Single-request multi-action pipeline execution with zero intermediate LLM round-trips
Compound macros (type_and_send, click_and_wait, navigate_and_read, scroll_and_read, fill_form)
Automatic session history compilation into replayable burst macros (compile_from_history: true)
Fail-fast execution guard (stop_on_error: true) and app context propagation in batch mode
Automatic loop counter reset on execution start

browser_tabs.description: Manage browser and Electron app tabs/windows (open, switch, close, list, consolidate, heal). Tab consolidation respects Tab Armor (locked tabs and high-score anchors) and deduplicates normalized URLs. Specify 'app' when targeting desktop apps (e.g. app: 'discord').
features: Single and batch tab operations plus window listing/focusing
Tab Armor-aware duplicate tab consolidation with URL normalization
Crash session recovery (heal)
Background tab targeting and existing-tab reuse

browser_wait.description: Pause until a condition is met ('element', 'text', 'url', 'stable', 'network', 'auto'). Deterministic wait engine returning accurate success/timeout status for all modes including network idle.
features: Element, text, URL, DOM stability, and network idle conditions
Accurate timeout reporting (success: false on network wait timeout)
Configurable timeout thresholds and timer cleanup
Per-tab asynchronous execution target and heuristic auto-condition resolution

browser_captcha.description: Autonomous zero-API detection and solving of Turnstile, reCAPTCHA, GeeTest, and hCaptcha bot challenges using local CDP behavioral solvers.
features: Zero-API autonomous solving
Cloudflare Turnstile, reCAPTCHA v2/v3, GeeTest, and hCaptcha support
Human oversight fallback via wait_for_user

browser_thoughts.description: Agent-to-user communication layer rendered in the middle down of the page. Supports question mode (interactive prompt up to 120s default timeout with bridge cleanup on cancel/timeout) and feedback mode (observation, decision, warning). Supports contextual element anchoring (anchor: 'w:NN').
features: Middle-down floating card HUD with precision dark styling
Contextual element anchoring (anchor: 'w:NN') with auto-highlighting
Feedback mode (observation, decision, warning updates)
Question mode with interactive user response and automatic DOM bridge cleanup
Configurable auto-fade and response timeout (default 120s)

browser_pointer.description: Advanced pointer control (hover, move, click, double_click, drag_and_drop, hover_chain) with Bézier curve kinematics, button-held drag events, end_ref coordinate verification, and waitForChild flyout menu support.
features: Hover, move, click, double_click, drag_and_drop, and multi-level hover_chain actions
Bézier curve cursor motion with buttons bitmask drag dispatch
Destination resolution via end_ref, end_selector, or end_x/end_y
waitForChild trigger menu resolution and configurable hold duration (holdMs)

browser_select.description: Select one or multiple options from native <select> or custom ARIA/Radix/Shadcn dropdowns, or highlight a text range inside an element (mode: 'text' with optional start/end offsets). Uses framework-safe property setters and events.
features: Single (value) and multi-select (values) option matching by text or value
Native <select> and custom ARIA/Radix/Shadcn dropdown support
Text and range selection mode (mode: 'text', start, end) for inputs, textareas, and DOM text
Framework-safe prototype setter invocation and input/change event dispatch

browser_fill.description: Smart multi-field form-filling and input scanner (scan: true). Handles text inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, contenteditable, and spreadsheet grids (grid_data with AA+ column support and single-fetch AX tree caching).
features: Lightweight fillable-input discovery scanner (scan: true)
Multi-field batch and blast_mode execution with secret masking
Single-fetch AX tree spreadsheet grid_data fill supporting AA+ columns
Deduplicated ARIA checkbox/radio activation and optional submit click

browser_highlight.description: Highlight elements on page with temporary visual overlays (no XSS via textContent labels and color allowlisting). Supports multi-element consideration overlays (refs: ['w:12', 'w:15']), five styles, floating badges, and configurable durations.
features: Multi-candidate consideration overlay (refs array)
Five visual styles: consideration, target lock, danger, success, shimmer
XSS-safe textContent badge rendering and validated color overrides
Targeting via ref IDs (w:NN), CSS selectors, or CDP backendNodeId

browser_upload.description: Upload files to a file input. Bypasses OS native file pickers via CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles, reusing cached ActionMaps and depth: 0 DOM initialization.
features: Direct CDP file payload injection with cached ActionMap resolution
Multi-file payload support
Zero OS file picker interaction required

browser_find.description: Fast in-page text search via a leaf-optimized TreeWalker with secret redaction on returned labels. Best for locating visible keywords/text without a full DOM map.
features: Leaf-optimized TreeWalker text search with null-body safety
Single or multi-match (all: true, limit) with bounding rects and selectors
Automatic secret redaction on matched labels

browser_storage.description: Manage localStorage and sessionStorage with strict scope validation ('local' | 'session'). Automatically redacts session secrets on get/list and caps list values at 2,000 characters (get returns full value).
features: Validated localStorage and sessionStorage scope targeting
Atomic get, set, remove, list, and clear operations
Automatic secret redaction on get/list and 2,000-char value cap on list

browser_checkpoint.description: Snapshot and restore browser state (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, and scroll/URL) into named checkpoints stored with owner-only permissions (mode 0o600) and bounded load waits on restore.
features: Session state time-travel and rollback with bounded load-event waiting
Owner-only checkpoint file persistence (mode 0o600)
Cookies (HttpOnly/Secure via CDP), localStorage, and sessionStorage backup
URL, page title, viewport scroll position, and optional DOM snapshot persistence

browser_network_intercept.description: Intercept/stub network responses (top-level pattern or rules array, escaped glob matching, Response-stage passthrough, clean listener teardown) and capture raw CDP network telemetry (TLS/SSL metadata, microsecond timing, OS failure codes).
features: Escaped URL glob pattern matching, request blocking, and response mocking
Clean Fetch.requestPaused listener teardown on disable
TLS/SSL Certificate security metadata (issuer, protocol, validity, cipher)
Microsecond Network Timing breakdown and OS-level net::ERR_* diagnostics

browser_console.description: Buffered access to browser console messages, JS exceptions, and network errors. Preserves falsy primitives (0, false), filters noise on both CDP and extension paths, redacts secrets, and caps entries at 1,000 characters.
features: Buffered console output stream retrieval and clearance
Falsy primitive preservation (0, false) and noise filtering across all paths
Automatic secret redaction and 1,000-character entry cap
Runtime exception stack capture and timestamped severity logging

browser_pdf.description: Print the current page to a PDF file via CDP Page.printToPDF with basename traversal guards, automatic .pdf extension handling, secret masking, and configurable orientation, scale, and page ranges.
features: Landscape/portrait orientation, scale factor, and page range printing
Basename path-traversal validation and automatic .pdf extension
Sensitive input masking during PDF generation

browser_eval.description: Run arbitrary JS in page context via CDP Runtime.evaluate. Automatically invokes bare zero-argument functions (() => ...), resolves promises, and recursively redacts session secrets across returned strings, objects, and arrays.
features: Page JS context execution with async/await promise resolution
Auto-invocation of bare zero-arg arrow and function expressions
Recursive secret redaction across returned strings, objects, and arrays
Role-based authorization checks

browser_cookies.description: Manage browser cookies via CDP Network domain ('get'/'list', 'set', 'delete'). Redacts tracked session secrets on read and surfaces real CDP errors on deletion failures.
features: Cookie retrieval (get/list), setting, and deletion with domain/path scoping
Automatic secret redaction on read
Accurate CDP error propagation on delete failures

browser_canvas.description: For ALL canvas content (charts, games, graphs). Use get_image to read pixel data as Base64 PNG, or draw to simulate coordinate gesture paths with active mouse-button bitmask dispatch.
features: Base64 PNG pixel buffer export
Programmatic gesture path drawing with buttons bitmask drag dispatch
Canvas node targeting via ref ID or selector

browser_scrape.description: Structured data extraction via CSS or XPath selectors in a single CDP evaluation step, with unified retry extraction preserving live input values, multiple: false, and secret masking.
features: CSS and XPath query evaluation with single-element and array modes
Targeted attribute and live input value extraction with secret redaction
Unified retry evaluation on dynamic SPAs

browser_snapshot.description: Capture or restore an MHTML snapshot (DOM + inline assets). Pre-masks and redacts secrets in saved MHTML, verifies file existence before restore, and uses native file URL conversion.
features: Full DOM and asset stream serialization with MHTML secret redaction
Atomic capture and verified pathToFileURL restore operations
Automatic timestamped snapshot file persistence

browser_screenshot.description: Viewport, clip-region, and full-page capture via CDP Page.captureScreenshot with secret masking and accurate scaled dimensions on auto-downscaled viewports (>1280px). Supports PNG, JPEG, and Base64 formats.
features: Full-page, viewport, and custom clip region capture
Accurate scaled width/height metadata when auto-downscaling wide viewports
Dynamic secret field masking during capture
In-memory Base64 data URL output (zero disk I/O)

browser_viewport.description: Set viewport dimensions and device emulation (width, height, DPR, mobile, named presets via preset/devicePreset, CDP touch emulation, geolocation, timezone, locale, color scheme) with automatic action inference and Electron-safe reset.
features: Viewport width, height, DPR, mobile, and real CDP touch emulation
Geolocation, IANA timezone, and locale overrides
Color scheme preference override (light, dark, no-preference reset)
Electron-safe emulation clear

browser_clipboard.description: Read or write to the system clipboard (plaintext or Base64 image payloads). Prefers native OS clipboard writes before page fallback, supports macOS Cmd+V paste, and redacts session secrets on read.
features: Native OS clipboard read/write with page-activation fallback
Plaintext and Base64 image payload support (individually or together)
Cross-platform paste dispatch (Cmd+V on macOS, Ctrl+V on Windows/Linux)
Automatic secret redaction on clipboard read

browser_inspect.description: Deep DOM inspection running box model, computed styles, and event listener queries in parallel with Shadow DOM lookup fallback and exact ref matching.
features: Parallel CDP queries for computed styles, box model, and event listeners
Shadow DOM fallback resolution and exact ref ID matching
Targeting via ref ID, selector, query alias, or nodeId

browser_automation.description: Inject self-running background scripts for monitoring/polling. Cleanly unregisters persisted new-document scripts on stop/restart, caps result mailboxes at 100 entries, and recursively redacts secrets on poll.
features: Background script injection with clean new-document teardown on stop/restart
Named automation script management with 100-entry mailbox cap
Recursive secret redaction on polled mailbox results

browser_recording.description: Record video screencasts of browser sessions into .webp, .gif, .webm, or .mp4 using pure Node or system ffmpeg. Validates sessionId against path traversal and cleans up listeners on start errors.
features: Native WebP/GIF compilation in pure Node plus FFmpeg WebM/MP4 fallback
Path-traversal validation on sessionId and per-session overlay state
Configurable FPS, frame limits, live status inspection, and frame cleanup

browser_detect.description: CRITICAL INITIALIZATION TOOL. Detect available browsers and configured desktop apps (case-insensitive app name matching). Call this FIRST to inspect online/offline status, debug ports, and open tabs.
features: Local browser engine discovery and CDP feature coverage reporting
Case-insensitive configured Electron app detection (connected/running_no_debug/offline)
Active tab and debug port inventory

browser_performance.description: Retrieve page performance metrics via CDP Performance.enable(), parallel Core Web Vitals observers (FCP, LCP, CLS) with clean observer teardown, and single-eval memory/navigation/resource timings.
features: Parallel First Contentful Paint (FCP), Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), and CLS capture
Clean PerformanceObserver teardown with no leaked observers
Single-eval memory, navigation timing, and resource timing distributions

browser_pattern_learn.description: Read (action=get), register (action=learn), update, or record execution outcome for a named workflow pattern on a given origin in ~/.weavetab-system/memory/sites/. Use action=get at session start to inspect site profiles and reliability scores. Use learn after completing a flow to persist it for future fast-path replay.
features: Site profile inspection via action=get (reads ~/.weavetab-system/memory/sites/)
Named pattern creation and update (merge-on-write, no duplicates)
Volatile selector stabilization before persistence
EWMA reliability score update on execution outcome
3-strike degradation and re-learn flagging
Site quirk registration (cookie_banner, rate_limit, modal_popup)

browser_office.description: Read and extract structured content from office documents (.xlsx, .docx, .pdf, .csv) via authenticated browser session fetch (native FileReader, 25MB cap) or local downloads directory, with ZIP format sniffing and secret redaction.
features: Authenticated in-session fetching via FileReader with 25MB size cap
ZIP internal sniffing distinguishing Word (word/) from Excel (xl/)
Structured tabular (.xlsx, .csv) and text (.docx, .pdf) extraction with secret redaction

browser_emulate.description: Emulate browser environmental conditions over CDP with strict validation for network presets and CPU multipliers (>= 1), plus geolocation, timezone, color scheme (including no-preference reset), and User-Agent overrides.
features: Validated network presets (offline, slow3g, fast3g, 4g, online) and custom throttling
Validated CPU slowdown multipliers (>= 1)
Geolocation, timezone, User-Agent, and prefers-color-scheme overrides

session_memory.description: Two-tier persistent memory system with traversal-guarded atomic writes. Tier 1 (~/.weavetab-system/memory/): per-domain selector confidence cache (capped at 50 memories and 50 failed selectors) tracking detected web frameworks, Shadow DOM usage, visit counts, and interaction strategies. Tier 2 (~/.weavetab-system/memory/sites/): named workflow patterns with secret redaction, EWMA reliability scores, site quirks (cookie banners, rate limits), and fast-path eligibility flags — all accumulated and refined across sessions.
features: Single-eval framework detection (React, Vue, Angular, Lit, Svelte, Next, Nuxt, Gatsby)
Successful selector strategy caching with confidence decay and 50-entry cap (Tier 1)
Named workflow pattern compilation with secret redaction and EWMA reliability scoring (Tier 2)
Site quirk registration: cookie banners, rate limits, modal popups (Tier 2)
3-strike pattern degradation with re-learn flagging (Tier 2)
Fast-path eligibility: patterns with reliability ≥ 0.8 skip exploratory DOM navigation

knowledge_hints.description: Domain-specific hint storage (~/.weavetab/knowledge/[domain].md) with deduplicated 20-line rolling history injecting the most recent context note into session prompts.
features: Deduplicated domain quirk notes (capped at 20 lines)
Path-traversal validation and atomic file writes
Prompt context injection budget (most recent hint, 150 chars max)

trail_log.description: Rolling 50-action window (~/.weavetab-system/sessions/context.json) with secret redaction and per-tab scoping powering strike-based and 3-cycle cross-tool loop detection.
features: 50-action rolling window tracking with SessionSecretTracker redaction
Per-tab strike-based and 3-cycle cross-tool loop detection heuristics
Auto-reset triggers on navigation, tab switch, or burst start

network_telemetry.description: Lazy on-demand network event tracking via CDP Network domain with bounded buffers (500 requests, 200 errors, 100 toasts) and clean listener teardown.
features: Request and response latency tracking with bounded buffers
Resource classification and clean listener unsubscribe on stop
HTTP status code and error tracking

mutation_observer.description: CDP-driven DOM mutation tracking (documentUpdated, childNodeInserted, childNodeRemoved, attributeModified, attributeRemoved) powering synchronous cache invalidation and SPA stabilization.
features: Attribute modification and removal tracking
Node insertion, removal, and document update events
Synchronous boxModel and domNode cache invalidation

semantic_delta_engine.description: Per-tab DOM state diffing engine with secret redaction returning strictly modified elements between snapshots.
features: Per-tab baseline and property snapshot storage with clean teardown
Property-level change detection (label, value, state, class) with secret redaction
Action recommendation generation and _refs_truncated propagation

semantic_dom_pruner.description: AST-based DOM compression algorithm executed across document and open Shadow roots before snapshot returns. Removes non-interactive hidden elements, preserves OmniBroker child frame elements, and converts SVG icons to tokens.
features: Hidden element pruning across document and open Shadow roots
SVG icon compression
Interactive tree and OmniBroker child frame preservation

vision_fallback.description: Local pixel analysis pipeline using sharp (.removeAlpha().raw()) for visual layout evaluation when accessibility trees return zero nodes.
vision_fallback.pipeline: AX Tree Check -> Screenshot -> Alpha Strip & Raw Channels -> 4x4 Grid Heatmap -> Text Density -> Clickable Region Analysis (top 5 zones)
features: Local execution (zero external API dependencies)
Channel-aware 4x4 visual density grid heatmap
Clickable zone classification (capped at 5 zones)

loop_detection.description: Per-tab strike-based and 3-cycle cross-tool loop detection algorithm over rolling 50-action windows with automated escalation.

thresholds.10+ strikes: Stuck state classification and auto-recovery activation

features: Per-tab rolling action window evaluation and 3-cycle cross-tool loop detection
Escalating alert tiers
Manual reset via browser_map({ force: true }) or browser_wait({ reset_loop: true })

framework_detection.description: Single-eval heuristic detection of web application frameworks via CDP Runtime.evaluate probes.
features: Single Runtime.evaluate probe across all 8 frameworks
Shadow DOM usage identification
Domain memory persistence with visitCount tracking

intent_resolution.description: Semantic element resolution resolving natural language action descriptions to DOM ref IDs using session memory scoring.
features: Natural language intent scoring
Historical selector memory integration
Live DOM context matching

rbac.description: Role-Based Access Control enforcing fail-closed tool and action execution boundaries based on configured session role.

roles.admin: Full access to all tools and system operations
roles.operator: Full access to all tools and system operations (same as admin)
roles.system: System-level tools only (browser_thoughts, browser_detect, browser_performance, browser_checkpoint, browser_pattern_learn)
roles.viewer: Read-only access (browser_map, browser_find, browser_scrape, browser_console [read only], browser_inspect, browser_snapshot [capture confined to snapshotDir], browser_screenshot, browser_pdf, browser_cookies [get/list on same origin], browser_tabs [list/list_windows], browser_wait, browser_pattern_learn [get only], browser_detect)
roles.automation: Full tool access excluding browser_thoughts (automation agents must be non-interactive)

domain_policy.description: Specificity-ordered domain-level access control policy engine (exact match > longest literal suffix > wildcard) configured via the top-level policies array in ~/.weavetab/config.json, supporting wildcard patterns, subdomain matching on bare domains, trailing-dot FQDN normalization, and allow-before-block fallback.

modes.read-only: Mutation tools blocked; action-level read-only enforcement on browser_cookies (get/list), browser_tabs (list/list_windows), browser_snapshot (capture in snapshotDir), browser_console (read), and browser_pattern_learn (get)
modes.audit-only: Unrestricted access with enhanced audit logging

rate_limiting.description: Sliding-window rate limiter enforcing maximum action frequencies across top-level tools and browser_burst sub-steps.
features: Configurable action per minute threshold (default 60)
Per-step enforcement inside browser_burst
Clamped retryAfterMs (>= 1ms) exception messaging

blind_injection.description: Fail-closed AES-256-GCM credential injection via browser_type_secret. Resolves secret values server-side from secrets.json without context exposure to the LLM.

input_filter.description: Sanitizes DOM snapshots before context return by stripping prompt injection patterns, bidi overrides, Unicode Tags, and invisible characters while preserving emoji variation selectors (U+FE0F) and non-breaking spaces (U+00A0).
features: Prompt injection pattern filtering
Pre-NFKC invisible character, bidi override (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069), and Unicode Tag (U+E0000-U+E007F) stripping
Excessive label length truncation

additional_mechanisms.localhost_binding: CDP WebSocket and --ws daemon bound strictly to 127.0.0.1 with IPv6 [::1] Host validation, per-socket auth tracking, and 5s unauthenticated socket timeout
additional_mechanisms.root_guard: Startup execution block for root/superuser processes (Unix)
additional_mechanisms.storage_blocker: Configurable nullification of web storage and Document.prototype cookie descriptor
additional_mechanisms.recursive_secret_redaction: SessionSecretTracker.redactValue() (with cycle guard) scrubs tracked secrets across strings, objects, arrays, DOM delta diffs, session trails, compiled patterns, audit logs, and eval/storage/cookies/clipboard/automation/console/find/snapshot/office outputs
additional_mechanisms.non_destructive_capture_masking: Inline CSS masking (-webkit-text-security: disc; color: transparent) during screenshot, MHTML snapshot, and PDF capture without clearing live input values
additional_mechanisms.injection_and_xss_hardening: Strict storage scope allowlist ('local' | 'session'), textContent badge rendering and color allowlisting in highlight overlays, HTML escaping in HUD anchor badges, and JSON.stringify escaping in dialog toasts
additional_mechanisms.secret_and_checkpoint_permissions: 0o600 permissions + Windows icacls ACL enforcement on secrets.json, secrets-key, ws-secret, and telemetry-secret; mode 0o600 on browser checkpoints
additional_mechanisms.atomic_config_and_lock_writes: Atomic temp-file + rename writes on config.json, stats.json, lockfiles, plugin storage, and intelligence stores; AsyncLocalStorage re-entrant CDP mutexes
additional_mechanisms.path_traversal_and_flag_protection: realpathSync containment on plugin entries/storage and browser profiles, dangerous browser flag stripping (--user-data-dir, --remote-debugging-*, --disable-web-security), and Electron XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME isolation
additional_mechanisms.two_factor_lock_validation: Browser lock verification requiring PID liveness and TCP port connectivity

stdio.description: Standard JSON-RPC over stdio streams. Default mode for MCP clients.

websocket.description: JSON-RPC over WebSocket for distributed agent pipelines.

hud.description: Shadow DOM HUD overlay injected into browser tabs displaying execution state and thoughts.
features: Mission status display
Thought bubble rendering
Task plan visualization
Shadow DOM isolation

ghost_cursor.description: Visual pointer trajectory overlay displaying humanized Bézier motion during interaction.
features: Bézier trajectory visualization
Acceleration curve rendering
Target element highlight overlay

plugins.description: Dynamic plugin system discovering any npm package containing weavetab.json and @weavetab/plugin-* packages at startup.
features: Automatic package discovery
Native MCP tool registration
Unified security pipeline integration

skills.description: Optional companion package (@weavetab/skills) providing mission templates.

devMode.description: Verbose CDP logging and HUD overlay toggle

actionabilityTimeoutMs.description: Element actionability wait timeout in ms

metadata.token_efficiency: Per-tab semantic delta diffing + DOM pruner
metadata.architecture: Direct CDP WebSocket — zero WebDriver, Playwright, or Puppeteer wrapper overhead
metadata.security: Domain blacklist + RBAC (5 roles) + rate limiting + Blind Injection (secrets.json)
metadata.session_memory: Persistent per-domain profiles with framework detection and strategy caching
